Standard: All crewmembers will have access to smoke and fume protection devices. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review drawings or digital mockups to verify provisions for smoke and fume protection devices and that they are readily accessible.
(2) Review drawings or digital mockups to verify there is a one for one correlation of smoke and fume protection devices to crewmembers. Demonstration.
  (1) Using a mockup or production air vehicle, demonstrate for each crew station that the intended anthropometric range for the platform population can access the devices and don them within five seconds without any interference from other already donned AFE.
